description: Every time violence erupts in the Middle East, Americans ask the same question: why can’t they just get along? It is an understandable reaction. When missile strikes, retaliations, and escalating military responses dominate the headlines, many assume the latest conflict is simply another political dispute that diplomacy might eventually resolve. Yet the reality is that the turmoil in the Middle East is not merely political. It is historical, spiritual, and, according to the Bible, prophetic. For
title: Why the Middle East Will Never Truly Be at Peace
